# Lustique Co.

> Lustique Co. (legal name: Lustique Cosmetology) is a bridal hair & makeup
> studio based at 242 Frangipani Street, La Montagne, Pretoria, Gauteng, South
> Africa. We travel to brides across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Gauteng-wide and
> destination weddings on request. Founded in 2018; the team shares 40+ years of
> combined experience. We keep our diary small so each bride gets an unhurried
> morning.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +27 67 925 3894
- Email: hello@lustiqueco.co.za
- Website: https://www.lustiqueco.co.za
- Studio trials: by appointment, Tuesday–Saturday
- Wedding mornings: from first light, we travel to you

## Services

- Bridal makeup — from R850 (day), including an optional trial at the studio.
- Bridal hair — from R495, priced by length (short / medium / long / extra long).
- The whole party — bridesmaids, mothers, flower girls and guests, with optional
  additional artists for larger groups.
- Events & occasions — matric farewells, engagements, corporate, editorial,
  pageants and milestone birthdays, at the venue or in the studio.

## Pricing (South African Rand)

- Bride makeup: R850 (day) / R850 (trial).
- Bride hair: short R495, medium R595, long R695, extra long R795.
- Bridesmaid / guest makeup: R550. Mother makeup: R500.
- Flower girl (12+): R500 makeup. Flower girl (under 12): R250 makeup.
- Party hair: short R395, medium R495, long R595, extra long R695.
- Event makeup: R550; event hair: short R395 … extra long R695.
- Matric farewell: R750 per face. Editorial: R750. Engagement: R650.
  Corporate: R650. Pageant: R950.
- Group lessons: R700 per face under 10 attendees, R600 at 10+.
- Additional artist: R850.
- Travel: free within 40 km round trip of the studio; R7 per km beyond
  (round trip). Destination weddings (200 km+ one way) on request.

## Current offer

Book hair & makeup for four or more full looks and the least-expensive eligible
look is on us. The bride, under-12 flower girls and trials are never the look
that is freed. Conditions are confirmed with the estimate.
